de_DE.missing_set_derivation: The JEI file is byte-unchanged from the audited 1.9 endpoint. Its 21 G3 missing normal keys remain missing, plus all three G4 added keys.

fi_FI.missing_set_derivation: The JEI file is byte-unchanged from the audited 1.9 endpoint. Its 16 G3 missing normal keys remain missing, plus all three G4 added keys.

ko_KR.missing_set_derivation: The JEI file is byte-unchanged from the audited 1.9 endpoint. Its 69 G3 missing normal keys remain missing, plus all three G4 added keys. gui.jei.category.craftingTable is among the missing keys and therefore its addon translation must be reviewed for the changed English meaning Crafting Table -> Crafting.

nb_NO.project_handling: Preserve upstream untouched. Minecraft's selected locale is no_NO, not nb_NO.

ru_RU.notes: JEI upstream substantially expanded ru_RU between 3.3.3 and 3.6.8. The addon must drop keys that upstream now owns instead of carrying the old 1.9 supplement forward wholesale.

zh_CN.notes: JEI upstream substantially expanded zh_CN between 3.3.3 and 3.6.8. The addon must drop keys that upstream now owns instead of carrying the old 1.9 supplement forward wholesale.

norwegian_reconciliation.project_decision: Continue using no_NO as the Minecraft-facing full addon locale and preserve JEI's nb_NO file without treating it as an alias.

notes: Minecraft 1.9.4 and the previously audited Minecraft 1.9 target point to the exact same asset-index SHA-1, so the 90-code raw vanilla language inventory and the existing 70-language project policy scope carry forward without language-code changes.
Only en_US, ru_RU and zh_CN changed among JEI's language files between the two pinned endpoints. de_DE, fi_FI, fr_FR, ko_KR and nb_NO are unchanged upstream files.

Existing upstream-owned translations are preserved even where an English source value changed. A changed English value only forces review in an addon supplement when that key is absent upstream, as with ko_KR gui.jei.category.craftingTable.
